query:
SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0)::bigint AS "scans!",coalesce(sum(total) FILTER(WHERE status='completed'),0)::bigint AS "completed!",
        coalesce(sum(total) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('queued','running')),0)::bigint AS "active!",
        coalesce(sum(total) FILTER(WHERE status='failed'),0)::bigint AS "failed!",
        (SELECT count(*) FROM registry_profiles) AS "registries!" FROM scan_status_counts WHERE to_regclass('scans_'||to_char(month,'YYYYMM')) IS NOT NULL
